name: Four Meirin
source:
Protagonist's loyal maid

A serious and obedient maid who served him since childhood. As his caretaker, they came to the kingdom together.

She and the protagonist are very close and understand each other very well.
She is a servant from the bottom of her heart, thinking of the main character above all else.
The maid is almost like an older sister or mother to him, and admonishes him when he does something that concerns her.
When he decided to conquer the princesses, she cooperates with him in every way.

She has a magnificent proportions. And she is resistant to the protagonist's semen, and whenever she has sex, her constitution makes it hard for her to get horny.
